stories.title: Public tip-off leads to uninsured driver’s car being seized in Flint
stories.summary: A car has been seized in Flint after a tip-off from a member of the public led police to an uninsured driver. North Wales Police’s North Flintshire Neighbourhood Policing Team said the tip-off led officers to a vehicle whose driver had no insurance and no valid driving licence. stories.title: Mold man banned from every Tesco and Boots in the country for five years
stories.summary: A Mold man has been banned from every Tesco and Boots store in the country for five years after admitting shoplifting at both stores in the town. stories.title: North Wales Police unit doubles national average for catching online predators
stories.summary: A specialist North Wales Police team has more than doubled the national average for positive outcomes in tackling online child abuse. stories.title: North Clwyd Animal Rescue closes for a week after puppies fall ill
stories.summary: North Clwyd Animal Rescue is to close for a week as a precaution, after a litter of puppies from the Mostyn area became unwell. stories.title: Shotton railway station to get new Transport for Wales Help Point
